ModMetaData.name: 天工铸造：自动化中枢修复
ModMetaData.author: WhiteGiverMa
ModMetaData.description:
修复天工铸造自动化中枢的两条生产中断：消耗整堆材料时的 Collection was modified，以及产物需要材质时 MakeRecipeProducts 的空主导材料 NullReferenceException。只修正这两条路径，保留材料筛选、扣料数量、配方、品质与进度规则。不改工坊原件或存档，不返还修复前已经损失的材料；产物使用游戏默认材质。
Fixes two automation-hub production failures: material-list invalidation when consuming whole stacks, and a null dominant ingredient inside MakeRecipeProducts for stuff-based products. Only these two paths are changed; filtering, consumption, recipes, quality and progress remain unchanged. Does not edit Workshop files or saves, or refund previously lost materials; products use the game's default stuff.
